property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any inputs, C.transfer returns true and does not revert (i.e., it always successfully returns true).
If _tos is non-empty then transfer returns true (does not revert) and leaves address(c) balance unchanged by the call.
For any call with a non-empty _tos, transfer does not revert (i.e., it always succeeds) — the call either returns true or returns without reverting.
